description: This file defines the interface 'TimestampPersistence' for managing timestamp metadata within an Akka streaming context, providing methods for setting and retrieving timestamps and tagged timestamps asynchronously.

classes.name: TimestampPersistence
classes.description: Defines operations for managing metadata of streams, including setting and retrieving timestamps and tagged timestamps asynchronously.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp in the persistence, returning a Source that facilitates execution.

methods.name: setTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp with an optional tag, returning a Source that completes after the update.

methods.name: getTimestampAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the stored timestamp asynchronously, returning a Source of an Optional Instant.

methods.name: getTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the tagged timestamp if any exists, returning a Source of an Optional Pair of Instant and String.
